import requests

def get_pdb_sequence(pdb_id):
    url = f"https://www.rcsb.org/fasta/entry/{pdb_id}"
    response = requests.get(url, timeout=10)
    if response.status_code == 200:
        lines = response.text.split('\n')
        seq = ''.join([line for line in lines if not line.startswith('>')])
        seq = seq.replace('X', '')
        return seq
    return None

molecule_binder_seq = get_pdb_sequence('3KZY')
print(f"3KZY full sequence length: {len(molecule_binder_seq)}")
print(f"First amino acid: {molecule_binder_seq[0]}")

molecule_binder_no_met = molecule_binder_seq[1:] if molecule_binder_seq[0] == 'M' else molecule_binder_seq
print(f"3KZY no Met length: {len(molecule_binder_no_met)}")

# Check the original sequence
print(f"\nOriginal sequence (first 50):")
print(molecule_binder_seq[:50])
